segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin generally describe the gel cream as lightweight and hydrating without added shine or greasiness, though one reviewer disliked its dewy finish and wanted a more matte result.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin frequently report strong hydration, softness and reduced flaking, though a couple found it insufficient in winter or slightly tacky/sticky after application.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers, including oily-leaning and dry-leaning variants, mostly describe balanced hydration without pilling or breakouts, with one noting it works better in summer than year-round.
segments.sensitive: Most sensitive-skin reviewers report no irritation and good calming/hydrating effects, but a minority describe breakouts, swelling, itching or reactions attributed to niacinamide or oleic acid.
segments.mature: The one reviewer identifying as mature and dry described strong, quick visible improvement compared with peptide creams she had tried before.

concerns.aging: The single reviewer addressing mature skin reported visible improvement in skin quality within a day, though this is based on one account only.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the product as effectively hydrating and non-greasy, including for very dry or dehydrated skin; a few found it insufficiently rich, requiring layering with heavier moisturizers, especially in winter.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with redness reported it calmed and reduced her redness without irritation; no dissent noted.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers mention it supporting or improving barrier health and layering well with other actives; no negative reports on barrier function specifically.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers with acne-prone or milia-prone skin report no new breakouts and some improvement in existing blemishes/pimples, but multiple others describe new closed comedones, bumps or breakouts after starting use.
concerns.blemishes: Many acne-prone reviewers say it did not clog pores and even reduced breakouts over time, while a notable minority experienced new comedones, cystic pimples, or texture after two or more weeks of use.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers commonly report the product controls shine and keeps oil in check by midday, with only one comment about a dewier finish than desired.

extraits.titre: Texture & a forehead full of bumps
extraits.texte: This moistruizer feels really nice, the texture and scent are great. However i started breaking out on my forehead with tons of small closed comodomes after about two weeks of use, i have a lot of texture. Previously my skin was smooth, i looked at reviews and theres a few others with similar comments. Upon research it looks like Oleic acid may be a culprit which is in the middle of the ingredient list. This is the only new thing i have changed in my skincare routine. So i would stay far away!

extraits.titre: Not for me or my sensitive skin
extraits.texte: This product helped me realize my skin is sensitive to niacinimides. I was using this moisturizer day and night and noticed that my cheeks broke out in tiny bumps. BYOMA's products have so many extra retinoids, niacinimides, etc. that are too harsh for my sensitive, non-acne-prone skin. I love how cute their products are, but I need something more gentle.

extraits.titre: Love this on my dry, mature skin!
extraits.texte: The packaging is cute but it doesn't feel as if there's much moisturizer in there. However, what's in there does wonders for my skin, which is dry and mature. It drank it in and within the first day I'm seeing results that all the other "triple peptide" moisturizers I've tried didn't produce. This is slightly sticky so I'm using it before bed, not under makeup. This is a great moisturizer to refresh your face after you've cleaned it for the evening and need to rebuild the moisture. It's priced right and I'm super happy I purchased it spur of the moment.

I love this moisturizer. Its taken me forever to find a moisturizer that makes my dry skin look plump and hydrated- no grease absorbs quick & even makes my makeup look better. My skin is sooo soft and smooth i love this so much. I am combo/dry acne prone hormonal acne and this does not break me out, i honestly feel like ive had less breakouts and when i do get them they are gone/heal so quickly. been using for a month now so happy with it!!

I was a little scared by the packaging that it might have a strong chemically smell or irritate my skin. I was thankfully wrong! I have the most extremely sensitive and acne prone skin, and omg I was so happy I found this product! I have been searching for a VERY long time for a moisturizer that didn't irritate my skin, and this was the winner!

Never in my life have I felt like a moisturizer was the right balance of moisturizing and hydrating since they've always been either so heavy they make my skin oily, or so lightweight that it was like splashing a few drops of water on my face. I just so happened to have a coupon for a free gift so I chose this on a whim. BEST DECISION I've made for my skin in a long time! My face feels glassy -- not oily -- soft, smooth, and properly moisturized. It's not too heavy but it's just the right amount of richness my skin craves. I'm absolutely obsessed with this moisturizer!!
